| Chart.js | 4.6.1 | npm `chart.js@4.6.1`, `dist/chart.umd.min.js` (file `chart-4.6.1.umd.js`) | MIT, see `chart-LICENSE.md` |
| Font Awesome Free (solid only) | 6.4.0 | npm `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.4.0`: `css/fontawesome.min.css`, `css/solid.min.css`, `webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2` | Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT, see `fontawesome-free-6.4.0/LICENSE.txt` |
